index_binding.helper_widths_by_index: native word = hosted template provider (504 helpers)

baseline_free_concentration.description: The same relaxation with no deferral (control for the relaxation itself).

defer_all_free_concentration.description: Relaxation of the previous row: all idle coordinates, including the returned ones, placed in capacity-48 children, ignoring helper indivisibility, windows and chronology.

defer_all_selected_hosting.description: Every positive helper restoration climb (all calls) is deferred; its host coordinates return to the same hosting window and are advanced by that window's idle child, merged per window. Owner map unchanged.

exchange_merge_rank1_into_48.description: Relaxation: per call, one rank-one climb is removed and its coordinate joins an existing rank-48 idle child (48 -> 49; halving 2*49^2 < 73^2). Every selected window has capacity at most 48 and every rank-48 child fills a whole idle window, so no re-hosting realizes this; it over-estimates one deferred rank-one climb per call.

zero_cost_delete_rank1.description: PR974-style relaxation: one rank-one child per call deleted with zero parent cost. It leaves N live coordinates unadvanced; priced only for comparison.
